Class BankAccountTriggerHandler

public without sharing class BankAccountTriggerHandler
extends TriggerHandler

Trigger handler for BankAccount__c. Routes trigger context to BankAccountTriggerHelper and enforces single-run and per-method bypass rules through the base TriggerHandler framework.

Methods

public override void afterInsert()

Handles the after-insert context. Delegates to BankAccountTriggerHelper.runAfterLogic when exactly one record is in scope and the handler is not disabled or re-entering.

public override void afterUpdate()

Handles the after-update context. Delegates to BankAccountTriggerHelper.runAfterLogic when exactly one record is in scope and the handler is not disabled or re-entering.

public override void beforeDelete()

Handles the before-delete context. Delegates to BankAccountTriggerHelper.cascadeDeleteAccountLinks so child Account_Link__c junction records are removed alongside their parent BankAccount__c.

Since:
    05/08/2026

public override void beforeInsert()

Handles the before-insert context. Delegates to BankAccountTriggerHelper.setLinkAccountNames so Link record-type rows inherit Name from their parent BankAccount__c before commit.

Since:
    05/09/2026

public override void beforeUpdate()

Handles the before-update context. Delegates to BankAccountTriggerHelper.checkModifiedFields to validate or react to field-level changes prior to commit.
